system.description: Your eyes actually produce light rather than merely reflect it, partially blinding you and making you conspicuous in the dark, and breaching the Masquerade whenever seen in public unless hidden behind thick wrap-around sunglasses. You gain the Negative Social Trait: Bestial and the Negative Mental Trait: Oblivious, neither of which can be bought off with experience, but you gain the Social Trait: Intimidating for free.
